verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own background automation. Ongoing monitoring can be configured per customer through the API. Agentic workflows (screening/ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring agents) auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases. WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks let downstream systems react without human polling. However, these are fixed, product-defined compliance automations rather than user-authored ones, and agent configurations on the Starter Plan cannot be customized. Missing for 10: general user-defined automation rules, triggers or schedules; in-depth docs on configuring the agents beyond marketing pages; independent or hands-on corroboration that the agents run autonomously as claimed.
